featureCards.title: Everything you need, right where you expect it.
featureCards.description: IntentJS gives you a clean foundation — with built-in caching, database integrations, task scheduling, events, and more. Everything you need to build powerful applications, without the usual complexity.

features.title: Turn weeks of setup into minutes of Intent.
features.description: IntentJS brings together everything modern applications need — task scheduling, message queues, mailers, event-listeners, and fastest HTTP routing — designed to help you move faster, scale effortlessly, and enjoy the craft of building again.

charts.title: Blazing-Fast Performance: IntentJS vs. (NestJS) Expressjs
charts.description: Whether with database queries or without, IntentJS delivers unmatched speed and efficiency. These benchmarks highlight IntentJS's superior request-handling capability, making it the go-to choice for high-performance applications.

testimonials.title: Real builders. Real stories. Real Intent.
testimonials.description: See why developers are choosing IntentJS — and why they’re never looking back.

integrations.title: Intent provides necessary feature integration out of the box
integrations.description: Whether you need seamless API connections, third-party tool support, or built-in automation, Intent ensures everything is ready to go from day one. Focus on your workflow while we handle the integrations.
